top5.description: Permira acquired Encore Fire Protection from Levine Leichtman Capital Partners in a deal valued near $1.8B, the largest transaction tracked this window.
top5.why_it_matters: The single largest dollar-value transaction in the commercial FLS space this window — a top-tier global sponsor underwriting fire-protection recurring revenue at scale, reinforcing FLS as an institutional-grade asset class.

top5.deal: Sandbrook Capital + Blackstone -> United Utility Services
top5.description: Sandbrook Capital, with Blackstone Credit & Insurance, acquired United Utility Services (parent to W.A. Chester, B&B Electrical, Williams Electric and more) from Bernhard Capital Partners.
top5.why_it_matters: A ~$1B utility-electrical-infrastructure recap confirms institutional capital is scaling beyond building-level MEP into grid and transmission/distribution services — the same data-center-driven power thesis reshaping the broader trades.

top5.description: Control transaction in the largest independent U.S. commercial mechanical services platform.
top5.why_it_matters: The defining commercial-MEP capital event of the window — top-tier sponsor plus sovereign-adjacent capital underwriting contracted commercial mechanical service revenue at national scale.

top5.description: Truelink acquired the $1B+ revenue industrial-services platform (refractory, fireproofing, insulation, mechanical, asset-integrity) from H.I.G. Capital.
top5.why_it_matters: One of the largest industrial-MEP platform changes of hands this window, signaling continued sponsor rotation among the largest mission-critical industrial services platforms.

top5.description: Two sovereign-wealth-adjacent institutional investors took a minority stake in Pye-Barker alongside continuing sponsors Altas Partners and Leonard Green.
top5.why_it_matters: Sovereign capital validating the largest FLS roll-up in the country is a strong signal of institutional conviction in the category — Pye-Barker went on to complete 57 add-ons in FY2025 and 22 more in H1 2026.
